claim: Measurement only. C1: with the loader's own parsers and _count_scoped_hpo_matches, five paired releases of the Monarch KG gene_disease.9606 export, HPO genes_to_phenotype.txt and MONDO SSSOM (Monarch KG 2025-09-17 to 2026-10-07) resolved 63.9-71.45% of HPO gene-disease scopes to a loaded MONDO row for the same gene. C2: removing the OMIM rows from each release's MONDO SSSOM export left 98,153-99,666 unambiguous exact identifiers (above MINIMUM_UNAMBIGUOUS_MONDO_XREFS = 50,000) and a match rate of 10.87-12.18%, with at least one match, so the pre-#2285 zero-match guard accepted it. C3: a 40% floor on that rate is derived from C1 and C2. No biological, statistical or clinical claim is made.
not_claimed: That the match rate measures semantic completeness, or that any one gene or disease is fully annotated. That unmatched scopes are defects: most are HPO gene-disease pairs whose exact MONDO target Monarch does not list for the same gene. That the five pairings are exactly what a refresh on each date fetched; see raw/snapshot-sources.json for the selection rule.

high_stakes_two_source_rule: Not engaged: C1-C3 are measurements of public files, not biological or clinical claims. The three exports are not independent of each other (Monarch KG integrates MONDO and HPO annotations), and they are measured jointly because that is how the loader uses them. Independence across time is the five releases, not separate sources.

floor.rationale: 40% sits 23.9 points below the lowest observed rate (more than three times the largest observed release-to-release change) and well above every simulated namespace failure: OMIM rows lost from the mapping export (10.9-12.2%), an OMIM prefix change in HPO (12.2%), a mapping export with neither OMIM nor Orphanet rows (0%), and a mapping export randomly truncated to 60% of its rows (38.7%). It deliberately does not catch the loss of Orphanet rows alone (52.6%) or a 75% truncation (47.4%): a floor high enough for those would sit within about 11 points of a healthy release.
floor.comparison_is_integer_percent: matches * 100 < 40 * scopes, so the boundary cannot shift by float rounding
